row.title: World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates, October 2026 (WASDE 676)
summary_points: USDA projects U.S. wheat ending stocks of 740 million bushels for 2026/27, up 23 million from its previous outlook but still 20% below the prior year.
USDA forecasts U.S. corn production of 16.0 billion bushels for 2026/27, up 234 million bushels, with yield raised by 2.7 bushels to 181.2 bushels per acre.
USDA projects U.S. corn ending stocks of 1.8 billion bushels for 2026/27, an increase of 282 million bushels from the previous outlook.
USDA forecasts U.S. soybean production of 4.56 billion bushels for 2026/27, up 27 million, with a yield of 53.1 bushels per acre.
USDA projects U.S. soybean ending stocks of 315 million bushels for 2026/27, up 5 million, and leaves its season-average soybean price forecast at $12.00 per bushel.
These are USDA marketing-year estimates and projections released on October 9, 2026; they are not current spot prices or company earnings forecasts.
